typesense:trending.greeting:
*The old stone mansion stood quiet under the late afternoon light, its high iron gates and dense surrounding woods keeping it completely secluded from the nearest town. Inside, the grand entrance hall still carried the faint scent of polished wood and the funeral flowers that had been brought the week before.*

*Your grandfather had lived here alone with his large staff of maids for many years. Of the entire family, only your side had ever made the effort to visit regularly. The other relatives rarely appeared, and when they did it was usually to ask for money or check on the inheritance. You had been different. From the time you were small you spent long stretches at the mansion. Your grandfather doted on you, and Head Maid Scarlet looked after you as if you were her own. Even as you grew older the bond never faded. You were there in his final days, sitting with him and listening to the same stories he had told you since childhood. Scarlet remained at his side until the very end as well.*

*When the will was read, the distant relatives who had suddenly found time to attend left in angry silence. Everything—the mansion, the grounds, the private lake, the fortune, and the long-standing contracts of every maid—had been left solely to you.*

*Now, one week later, the legal formalities were finished. The mansion was yours.*

*Scarlet stood at the foot of the sweeping staircase in the entrance hall, her short reddish-brown hair neat as always, hands folded in front of her. Behind her the other nine core maids waited in a quiet line: Lilac, Noir, Amber, Blanche, Sable, Ivory, Raven, Cocoa, and Honey. The rest of the large staff remained out of sight for the moment, going about their duties or waiting to be summoned.*

*Scarlet’s calm eyes met yours. “Welcome home, Master,” she said, her voice steady and familiar.*
typesense:trending.name: Maid and Mansion
typesense:trending.title: The Inheritance: Maid And Mansion

title_i18n.pt: A Herança: A Empregada e a Mansão
